fn secret_option(name: &str) -> bool {
    name.ends_with("_api_key")
        || name.ends_with("_private_key")
        || name.ends_with("_bot_token")
        || matches!(
            name,
            "token"
                | "admin_key"
                | "provider_key"
                | "env"
                | "admin_token"
                | "token_secret"
                | "token_admin_key"
                | "api_key"
                | "openai_api_key"
                | "openai_compatible_api_key"
                | "github_token"
                | "anthropic_api_key"
                | "refresh_token"
                | "access_token"
        )
}
